about: Known architecture debt (tools/dep-check.mjs, D97). The check fails only on violations not listed here; the summary prints the count, which must shrink. Remove an entry when its violation is gone (the check reports it). Never add an entry to make new coupling pass without a review; see modular-kernel-review.md.

rules.core-cycle: No runtime import cycle between files of @aura/core (type-only imports are exempt).
rules.core-module-cycle: No entangled modules in @aura/core: a runtime import A/f -> B/g where g (transitively) imports module A again. Shared contracts belong in leaf files that import no other module.
rules.core-forbidden: @aura/core never imports the shell, the UI, Astro, React, the SDK or the CLI.
rules.package-internals: A package reaches another workspace package only through its declared entry points (package.json `exports`), never by a relative path, `src/` or `dist/`.
rules.sdk-core: @aura/app-sdk imports @aura/core only through its declared entry points and only for types or the declared leaf subpaths (never the kernel root at runtime).
rules.server-webshell: The server layer of @aura/shell (API routes, middleware, server/, and the lib modules they reach) never imports Web Shell code (components, layouts, stores, desktop pages) or UI libraries.
rules.foundation-leaf: Foundation modules of @aura/core (sector map in packages/core/AGENTS.md) import no other sector at runtime, except the barrel (src/index.ts) and the composition root (src/system/bootstrap.ts).
rules.kernel-presentation: Kernel sectors never import presentation-contract modules (theme, layout, keymap) at runtime.
rules.agent-agnostic: Agent-aware but agent-agnostic (owner, philosophy audit): no product-specific agent knowledge (claude, codex, anthropic, openai, .claude/.codex paths, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CODEX_HOME, config.toml) in the code of @aura/core src or the shell server infrastructure (src/lib, server/); it belongs in apps, adapters, the home seed, docs and tests. Comments and the AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md file convention do not count.
rules.agents-docs: Every AGENTS.md has a sibling CLAUDE.md that is exactly `@AGENTS.md`; the chain of AGENTS.md files from the root to any directory stays under 28 KiB (Codex stops adding files at project_doc_max_bytes, 32 KiB by default); the sector map in packages/core/AGENTS.md names every core module exactly once.
